title: Potatoverse Science Model Testing Protocol
purpose: Make the science wing richer without allowing analogies, decorative equations or later formalizations to drift into unsupported physical claims.

tests.name: provenance
tests.question: Can the exact equation or statement be tied to a dated source?
tests.fail_action: mark unrecovered or later-formalized; never attribute as verbatim Tim.

tests.name: variable-definition
tests.question: Does every symbol have a defined meaning and mathematical type?

tests.name: units
tests.question: Are physical dimensions/units stated and consistent?
tests.fail_action: not eligible as a physical equation.

tests.name: domain
tests.question: What space does the model act on: physical spacetime, graph, probability manifold, state space, chronology, symbolic ontology?
tests.fail_action: do not compare results across domains as if identical.

tests.name: dynamics
tests.question: What determines evolution or transition?
tests.fail_action: classify as static taxonomy/geometry rather than dynamics.

tests.name: observability
tests.question: What quantity could actually be measured or computed?

tests.name: novelty
tests.question: What does this model explain or predict beyond existing theories?
tests.fail_action: retain as analogy, educational model or reframing.

tests.name: falsifiability
tests.question: What outcome would count against the model?
tests.fail_action: do not describe as empirical scientific theory.

tests.name: baseline
tests.question: What established theory already explains the phenomenon?
tests.fail_action: compare against baseline before invoking new force/dimension.

tests.name: overfitting
tests.question: Were parameters chosen after seeing the target pattern?
tests.fail_action: label exploratory and require out-of-sample test.

tests.name: category-boundary
tests.question: Is a mathematical analogy being mistaken for physical identity?
tests.fail_action: split the records and add an explicit boundary note.

door_xi.current: Ξ/Ξ_c is a schematic critical-threshold model.
missing: units or proof it is dimensionless
door_xi.next: Choose one domain first—e.g. abstract state transition, not physical fifth dimension—and fully specify there before considering physical interpretation.

radion_door.current: φ(x)=M_*ln(R/R_0) is a radion-inspired speculative model.
radion_door.next: Build a conventional KK toy model first and show exactly where the Timic interpretation enters.

starchforce.current: Invented project fifth-force concept with a biological starch/storage metaphor.
starchforce.next: Do not write a physical Lagrangian until a novel measurable effect is stated. A semantic or organizational field may be modeled mathematically without calling it a fundamental force.

field_of_life.current: Book-derived metaphor comparing Potato to an excitation in a field of life.
field_of_life.next: Prefer reaction-diffusion, ecological, developmental or network fields for life-pattern modeling before quantum-field terminology.

red_blue.next: Test as a two-variable dynamical system or control tradeoff, e.g. exploration versus exploitation, rather than a physical color/frequency claim.

spiral.current: Multiple distinct uses: public 2025 spiral equation attestation, symbolic return, helical biography, biological eye arrangement.
spiral.next: Maintain separate IDs for geometric spiral, helical chronology, phyllotaxis, return map and symbolic recurrence.

merkaba_counter_rotation.current: Dynamic counter-rotation/alignment of opposites around a still center.
merkaba_counter_rotation.next: Start with a two-oscillator or rigid-body toy model and state which project property it represents.

evidence_labels.B: project formalism clearly documented but later than originating intuition

publication_rule: Every public science page should make clear whether displayed mathematics is Tim-authored/recovered, archive-generated, or external established mathematics.
